camera.reason: 50MP f/1.8 main camera with PDAF, the only other lens is an auxiliary sensor, no OIS.

performance.reason: Helio G81 is smooth for daily apps but struggles with games.

battery.reason: 5,260mAh gives a full day; 15W charging is slow.

build.reason: Plastic body with no IP rating listed.

software.reason: Honor has published no update promise; expect about 1 Android upgrade and 2 years of patches.

value.reason: At 35,000 it is the cheapest way to get 128GB storage and a 50MP camera in this bracket.

availability.reason: In stock at PriceOye with official warranty; the HONOR PK store on Daraz is out of stock.

notes: Only the 4GB 128GB is sold in Pakistan. The HONOR PK Daraz store lists it at 29,999 but out of stock on 2026-10-10, so it was ignored. Daraz marketplace sellers have it in stock at 38,999 and WhatMobile shows 39,999. Update policy is assumed, Honor has not published one.
